uncertainties.note: Flail is an unverified English transliteration of the allied unmanned support-unit name. Several web searches yielded no reliable matching spelling. Needs orchestrator glossary decision.
Carrier interpreted as accompanying the enemy main force, based on grammatical link to the explicitly enemy targets. No faction-specific vessel name added.
Japanese omits who fought them previously. Draft refers to the previous fight without inventing singular or plural first-person subject.
Guld Bowman follows the shortened source rather than adding canonical middle name Goa. Hari Makibi's nickname Harry is supported by franchise wiki English usage; keep distinct from formal Hari.
